properties.instruction:

reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep your
foot off the brake.

There is no safe place on a highway when a dust storm hits.
Visibility can be lost immediately, making it difficult or impossible
to slow down and avoid stopped vehicles. Delay travel, or safely exit
the highway before the dust storm arrives.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southern Iroquois County in east central Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 1130 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Roads and
streets may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 824 PM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Locally up to 2
inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Milford, Onarga, Cissna Park, Buckley, Stockland, Loda, Woodland,
Wellington, Thawville and Claytonville.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Advisory means minor flooding along waterways and other poor
drainage areas is imminent or may already be occurring. Persons in
the advisory area should use caution and avoid flood waters.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.description:

Warning for the following rivers...

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/iln.

* WHERE...Great Miami River at Sidney.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Thursday afternoon.

side of Custenborder Field.  At stages above 10 feet, city
officials begin flood operations.

morning.

properties.description:

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 19 at 11:20AM EDT until August 22 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Indiana...Illinois...

Wabash River at Riverton.

Wabash River at Terre Haute.

Wabash River at Hutsonville Legacy Power Plant Site.

Wabash River at Montezuma.

Wabash River at Covington.

Wabash River at Vincennes.

.Moderate flooding continues on the Wabash River at Montezuma, where
the river is just past crest as of late Wednesday morning. The river
should crest at Terre Haute Thursday through Friday and make its way
downriver to reach Vincennes around the middle of next week.
Additional rainfall through Friday morning of around an inch was
included in the forecast for the upper Wabash and about 1.5 inches
over the lower Wabash, with only a quarter inch over the middle
Wabash. Changes in the amounts or location of the rainfall will
impact the crest and amount of time in flood.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Covington.

* WHEN...Until Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 24.0 feet, Basement flooding begins in 10 to 12
cottages.  The approach to new bridge downstream of SR 28 in
Attica floods.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 23.6 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours
ending at 10:45 AM EDT Wednesday was 24.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
Saturday morning and continue falling and remain below flood
stage.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive
cars through flooded areas.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement should be issued late tonight by around 230 AM
EDT /130 AM CDT/.
